answer: Each epoch the haven opens knoll work bays; an identity burns 40 credits to take one bay and file a jade-stamped claim, never refunded. One bay, one serial, one key, one load: reuse voids both loads, and auditors replay the haven ledger. The first slot costs 40, the k-th 40+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes burn 2,537,500 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring fails on a key mismatch. An honest agent burns 40 once and keeps its work.
